meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: Claude 变成调度者:把计划里的每个阶段交给子代理执行——实现、验证清单、反模式检查、代码质量审查,验证通过后才提交。它自己不写代码,只负责协调和核对。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落实一份计划时接管,尤其是 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.text: 按这份计划开始执行,每个阶段派子代理做。
say.note: Claude 逐阶段派发子代理并核对结果。

say.text: 先跑验证子代理,确认通过后再提交。
say.note: 验证未通过则不执行提交。

say.text: 用反模式子代理检查这批改动。
say.note: 按计划里的已知坏模式做检索。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as orchestrator: each phase of the plan is handed to subagents for implementation, a verification checklist, an anti-pattern check, and code review; code is committed only after verification passes. It coordinates rather than writing code itself.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Execute this plan, using subagents for each phase.
say_en.note: Claude dispatches subagents phase by phase and checks results.

say_en.text: Run the verification subagent first, commit only after it passes.
Use the anti-pattern subagent to check these changes.
say_en.note: Greps for known bad patterns from the plan.
